authority.baseline_note: 2026-09-23 current baseline. The 2026-08 MOIS monthly current-administration table reflects the unified Jeonnam-Gwangju Special City. The special act took effect 2026-07-01; Incheon’s 2-county/9-district structure also took effect 2026-07-01. Jeju’s two administrative cities remain included as research units by project policy, distinct from autonomous cities/counties/districts.
